ts.oc_black_screen.title: Stuck on a black screen before picker
ts.oc_black_screen.cause: An error in the firmware or OpenCore while loading the drivers and presenting the menu.
ts.oc_black_screen.fix:
• Use OpenCore's DEBUG build with Target set to 67 and check the logs.
• No logs at all: the USB folder structure is incorrect (see "Booting OpenCore reboots to BIOS"), or the firmware does not support UEFI (set up DuetPkg).
• Logs present: check the last line. ASSERTs should be reported to Acidanthera's bugtracker.
• Stuck on HfsPlus.efi: try HfsPlusLegacy.efi (recommended for CPUs without RDRAND, mainly 3rd gen Ivy Bridge i3 and older); VBoxHfs.efi also works but is much slower.
• Stuck on HiiDatabase.efi: the firmware likely already supports it — remove the driver.
ts.oc_no_vault.title: Stuck on no vault provided!
ts.oc_no_vault.fix:
• Set Misc -> Security -> Vault to Optional.
• If you already ran sign.command, restore OpenCore.efi with a new copy from OpenCorePkg (the RSA-2048 signature was written into it).
• Vault and FileVault are two separate things.
ts.oc_invalid_vault.title: Stuck on OC: Invalid Vault mode
ts.oc_invalid_vault.cause: Likely a spelling mistake — OpenCore options are case-sensitive.
ts.oc_invalid_vault.fix: • Misc -> Security -> Vault must be exactly Optional.
ts.oc_no_partitions.title: Can't see macOS partitions
ts.oc_no_partitions.fix:
• ScanPolicy set to 0 to show all drives.
• Have the proper firmware drivers such as HfsPlus (ApfsDriverLoader shouldn't be used in 0.5.8).
• UEFI -> Quirks -> UnblockFsConnect = True (needed for some HP systems).
• SATA Mode: AHCI in the BIOS.
• UEFI -> APFS: EnableJumpstart YES, HideVerbose NO.
• High Sierra 10.13.5 or older: MinDate -1 and MinVersion -1.
ts.oc_scan_failure.title: Stuck on OCB: OcScanForBootEntries failure - Not Found
ts.oc_scan_failure.cause: OpenCore can't find any drives with the current ScanPolicy.
ts.oc_scan_failure.fix: • Misc -> Security -> ScanPolicy -> 0 to show all boot options.
ts.oc_no_default.title: Stuck on OCB: failed to match a default boot option
ts.oc_no_default.cause: OpenCore can't find any drives with the current ScanPolicy.
ts.oc_no_entries.title: Stuck on OCB: System has no boot entries
ts.oc_no_entries.cause: Same as the two ScanPolicy errors above.
ts.oc_no_schema.title: Stuck on OCS: No schema for DSDT, KernelAndKextPatch, RtVariable, SMBIOS, SystemParameters...
ts.oc_no_schema.cause: A Clover config used with OpenCore, a configurator (such as Mackie's Clover and OpenCore configurator), or an outdated config mixed with a newer OpenCore.
ts.oc_no_schema.fix:
• Start over with a new config, or remove everything that doesn't belong.
• Update outdated configs to match your OpenCore version.
ts.oc_driver_missing.title: Stuck on OC: Driver XXX.efi at 0 cannot be found
ts.oc_driver_missing.cause: An entry is in config.plist but the file is not in the EFI.
ts.oc_driver_missing.fix:
• Make EFI/OC/Drivers match config.plist -> UEFI -> Drivers.
• If not, re-snapshot config.plist (Cmd/Ctrl+R in ProperTree).
• Entries are case-sensitive.
ts.oc_parse_real.title: Receiving "Failed to parse real field of type 1"
ts.oc_parse_real.cause: A value stored as real when it should not be — generally Xcode converting HaltLevel by accident.
ts.oc_cant_select.title: Can't select anything in the picker
ts.oc_cant_select.fix:
• Incompatible keyboard driver: disable PollAppleHotKeys, enable KeySupport and remove OpenUsbKbDxe from UEFI -> Drivers.
• If that doesn't work, reverse it: disable KeySupport and add OpenUsbKbDxe.
• Missing PS2 keyboard driver (ignore with a USB keyboard): some laptops and older PCs need Ps2KeyboardDxe.efi, also added to config.plist.
ts.oc_ssdt_not_added.title: SSDTs not being added
ts.oc_ssdt_not_added.cause: OpenCore requires the table Length header to equal the file size; iASL produced a mismatch when the file was compiled.
ts.oc_ssdt_not_added.fix:
• Correct Length to the real size (e.g. a 347-byte SSDT is 0x0000015B).
• Better: remake the SSDT with a newer iASL or Acidanthera's MaciASL. Avoid Rehabman's MaciASL, which is prone to ACPI corruption.
ts.oc_reboots_bios.title: Booting OpenCore reboots to BIOS
ts.oc_reboots_bios.fix: • All OC files must be inside an EFI folder on the ESP (EFI system partition).
ts.oc_openruntime.title: OCABC: Incompatible OpenRuntime r4, require r10
ts.oc_openruntime.fix:
• BOOTx64.efi, OpenCore.efi and OpenRuntime must all be from the same exact build.
• FwRuntimeServices was renamed to OpenRuntime in 0.5.7 and newer.
ts.oc_access_denied.title: Failed to open OpenCore image - Access Denied
ts.oc_access_denied.cause: Newer Microsoft Surface firmware reports a security violation even with Secure Boot disabled.
ts.oc_sb_model.title: OC: Failed to find SB model disable halting on critical error
ts.oc_sb_model.fix: • Set Misc -> Security -> SecureBootModel to Disabled.
ts.oc_boot_fail.title: Legacy boot stuck on BOOT FAIL!
ts.oc_boot_fail.cause: EFI/OC/OpenCore.efi could not be found on any partition.
ts.oc_boot_fail.fix: • Double check the EFI folder structure.
ts.k_exitbs.title: Stuck on [EB|#LOG:EXITBS:START]
ts.k_exitbs.fix:
Booter issues:
• DevirtualiseMmio: exclude the needed regions in Booter -> MmioWhitelist or disable it. Enable on TRx40, disable on X99.
• SetupVirtualMap: required by most firmware (mainly Z390 and older), but breaks Ice Lake, Comet Lake (B460, H470, Z490...), AMD B550/A520 (and latest X570 BIOS), many B450/X470 with late 2020 BIOS, TRx40, QEMU and X299 2020+ BIOS.
• Firmware with MATs (2018+): EnableWriteUnprotector False, RebuildAppleMemoryMap True, SyncRuntimePermissions True. Older firmware: the opposite. The log line "OCABC: MAT support is 1" tells which.
Kernel patch issues:
• AMD: missing or outdated AMD Vanilla patches (OpenCore patches use MinKernel/MaxKernel, not Clover's MatchOS).
• Intel: AppleXcpmCfgLock (Haswell and newer) / AppleCpuPmCfgLock (Ivy Bridge and older; Broadwell and older on 10.10 or older), or disable CFG-Lock. AppleXcpmExtraMsrs for Pentiums, HEDT and other odd systems.
• Legacy Intel on Big Sur ("max_cpus_from_firmware not yet initialized" via serial): enable Booter -> Quirks -> AvoidRuntimeDefrag.
UEFI issues:
• UEFI -> Output -> ProvideConsoleGop (enabled by default since 0.5.6).
• IgnoreInvalidFlexRatio for Broadwell and older (not AMD, not Skylake or newer).
Virtual machines: VMware 15 gets stuck here; VMware 16 resolves it.
ts.k_endrandomseed.title: Stuck on EndRandomSeed
ts.k_after_select.title: Stuck after selecting macOS partition in OpenCore
ts.k_after_select.fix:
• Same issues as Stuck on [EB|#LOG:EXITBS:START].
• Enabling DEBUG OpenCore can help shed some light.
ts.k_fx_exception.title: Getting the error X64 Exception Type... on AMD FX systems
ts.k_fx_exception.fix:
• CSM enabled in the BIOS (also called Legacy Boot Support or Load Legacy Option ROMs) — disable it.
• The ProvideCurrentCpuInfo quirk (required by the unified patches) is incompatible with your firmware: use the older version of the patches with Big Sur or older, removing the old patches before merging.
ts.k_frame_pointer.title: Kernel Panic on Invalid frame pointer
ts.k_frame_pointer.fix:
• DevirtualiseMmio: exclude the needed regions in Booter -> MmioWhitelist or disable it.
• SetupVirtualMap: enable it, except on Ice Lake, Comet Lake, B550, A520, TRx40 and QEMU.
• Firmware with MATs (2018+): EnableWriteUnprotector False, RebuildAppleMemoryMap True, SyncRuntimePermissions True. Older firmware: the opposite.
ts.k_preboot.title: Stuck on [EB|LD:OFS] Err(0xE) when booting preboot volume
ts.k_preboot.cause: The preboot volume isn't properly updated.
ts.k_preboot.fix:
• Enable JumpstartHotplug under UEFI -> APFS (Recovery may not boot on Big Sur without it).
• Boot into Recovery, open Terminal, find the Preboot volume with diskutil list, mount it and run diskutil apfs updatePreboot on it (disk5s2 is the guide's example), then reboot.
ts.k_security_violation.title: Stuck on OCB: LoadImage failed - Security Violation
ts.k_security_violation.cause: Outdated Apple Secure Boot manifests are missing from the preboot volume (a macOS bug) while SecureBootModel is set.
ts.k_security_violation.fix:
• Disable SecureBootModel (Misc -> Security -> SecureBootModel -> Disabled).
• Or reinstall macOS with the latest version.
• Or copy the manifests from /usr/standalone/i386 to /Volumes/Preboot/<UUID>/System/Library/CoreServices from Terminal (commands below; disk5s2 is the guide's example).
ts.k_memory_pool.title: Stuck on OCABC: Memory pool allocation failure - Not Found
ts.k_memory_pool.fix:
• Above4GDecoding enabled.
• CSM disabled (enabling Windows 8.1/10 WHQL Mode can do the same on some boards); on some laptops CSM must be enabled.
• BIOS up to date (Z390 and HEDT are known for poorly written firmware).
ts.k_buffer_small.title: Stuck on Buffer Too Small
ts.k_plist_only.title: Stuck on Plist only kext has CFBundleExecutable key
ts.k_plist_only.cause: Missing or incorrect executable path in config.plist.
ts.k_not_supported.title: Stuck on This version of Mac OS X is not supported: Reason Mac...
ts.k_not_supported.cause: The SMBIOS is no longer supported by that version of macOS.
ts.k_not_supported.fix:
• Set values in PlatformInfo -> Generic with Automatic enabled.
• Catalina: iMac13,x+, iMacPro1,1, MacPro6,1+, Macmini6,x+, MacBook8,1+, MacBookAir5,x+, MacBookPro9,x+.
• Big Sur: iMac14,4+, iMacPro1,1, MacPro6,1+, Macmini7,1+, MacBook8,1+, MacBookAir6,x+, MacBookPro11,x+.
• Monterey: iMac16,1+, iMacPro1,1, MacPro6,1+, Macmini7,1+, MacBook9,1+, MacBookAir7,1+, MacBookPro11,3+.
• Ventura: iMac18,x+, iMacPro1,1, MacPro7,1, Macmini8,1, MacBook10,1, MacBookAir8,1+, MacBookPro14,x+.
ts.k_runtime_area.title: Couldn't allocate runtime area errors
ts.k_runtime_area.fix: • See "Fixing KASLR slide values" in the guide.
ts.k_pci_hang.title: Stuck on RTC..., PCI Configuration Begins, Previous Shutdown..., HPET, HID: Legacy...
ts.k_pci_hang.cause: This is where most PCI devices are first set up. Other names: apfs_module_start..., Waiting for Root device, Waiting on...IOResources..., previous shutdown cause...
ts.k_pci_hang.fix:
• Missing EC patch: the EC SSDT must be in EFI/OC/ACPI and ACPI -> Add, enabled.
• IRQ conflict (older laptops and pre-builts): SSDTTime's FixHPET — add SSDT-HPET.aml and its ACPI patches.
• PCI allocation: update the BIOS. Enable Above4G, or if there's no option add npci=0x2000 or npci=0x3000 (one at a time). Don't combine Above4G and npci (some X99/X299 boards such as GA-X299-UD4 need both). With Resizable BAR on 2020+ BIOS, set Booter -> Quirks -> ResizeAppleGpuBars to 0. CSM disabled, Windows 8.1/10 UEFI Mode enabled.
• NVMe/SATA: avoid Samsung PM981 and Micron 2200S; Samsung 970 EVO Plus on the latest firmware; SATA Hot-Plug disabled; NVMe drives in NVMe mode.
• NVRAM failing: 300 series consumer Intel needs SSDT-PMC; HEDT (X99) needs emulated NVRAM.
• RTC missing: SSDT-AWAC on Intel 300+ series; SSDT-RTC0-RANGE on X99/X299; a fake RTC on HP 250 G6 / HP 15-DA0014dx.
ts.k_b550.title: Stuck at ACPI table loading on B550
ts.k_b550.fix: • On AMD B550 or A520, add SSDT-CPUR.aml to EFI/OC/ACPI and to ACPI -> Add.
ts.k_root_usb.title: "Waiting for Root Device" or Prohibited Sign error — USB issues
ts.k_root_usb.cause: Generally a USB or SATA error (also called Stop Sign or Scrambled). This part assumes you're booting the installer USB.
ts.k_root_usb.fix:
• Over the 15 port limit: make a USB map.
• Firmware not passing USB ownership: UEFI -> Quirks -> ReleaseUsbOwnership -> True, or enable EHCI/XHCI Handoff in the BIOS.
• Try a 2.0 port instead of a 3.x port, or vice versa.
• AMD 15h/16h: XLNCUSBFix.kext, then AMD StopSign-fixv5 alongside it.
• X299: enable Above 4G Decoding.
• Missing USB ports in ACPI: USBInjectAll on Coffee Lake and older; SSDT-RHUB on Ice Lake and Comet Lake; SSDTTime's 7. USB Reset on AMD.
ts.k_root_sata.title: "Waiting for Root Device" or Prohibited Sign error — SATA issues
ts.k_root_sata.cause: On rare occasions (mainly laptops) the SATA controller isn't officially supported. It only shows after macOS is installed onto the drive.
ts.k_root_sata.fix:
• SATA in AHCI mode (hardware RAID and IDE aren't supported; Intel RST drives won't be accessible).
• SATA-unsupported.kext for obscure controllers; AHCIPortInjector.kext for very legacy ones.
• Big Sur: Catalina's patched AppleAHCIPort.kext (SATA-unsupported not needed with it).
ts.k_x99.title: Kernel panic with IOPCIFamily on X99
ts.k_x99.fix:
• Enable AppleCpuPmCfgLock, AppleXcpmCfgLock and AppleXcpmExtraMsrs.
• Add SSDT-UNC.
ts.k_gpu_init.title: Stuck on or near IOConsoleUsers: gIOScreenLock.../gIOLockState (3...
ts.k_gpu_init.cause: This is right before the GPU is properly initialized.
ts.k_gpu_init.fix:
• GPU is UEFI capable (GTX 7XX/2013+).
• CSM is off in the BIOS (may need to be on with laptops).
• Force PCIe 3.0 link speed.
• iGPU: check ig-platform-id and device-id (desktop UHD 630 may need 00009B3E).
• WhateverGreen fixes: -igfxmlr (can also show as a "Divide by Zero" error); Coffee Lake iGPUs may need igfxonln=1 in 10.15.4 and newer.
ts.k_scrambled.title: Scrambled Screen on laptops
ts.k_scrambled.fix: • Enable CSM in the UEFI settings (may appear as "Boot legacy ROMs" or another legacy setting).
ts.k_navi.title: Black screen after IOConsoleUsers: gIOScreenLock... on Navi
ts.k_navi.fix:
• Add agdpmod=pikera to boot-args.
• Switch between display outputs.
• Try the MacPro7,1 SMBIOS with agdpmod=ignore.
• MSI Navi: Kernel -> Patch "Navi VBIOS Bug Patch" for com.apple.kext.AMDRadeonX6000Framebuffer, Find 4154592C526F6D2300, Replace 414D442C526F6D2300, MinKernel 19.00.00, MaxKernel 19.99.99 (not needed on Big Sur).
ts.k_kext_summary.title: Kernel Panic Cannot perform kext summary
ts.k_kext_summary.cause: macOS has a hard time interpreting the injected kexts in the prelinked kernel.
ts.k_kext_summary.fix:
• Kexts in the correct order: master then plugins, Lilu always before its plugins.
• Kexts with executables have them; plist-only kexts (USBmap.kext, XHCI-unsupported.kext...) don't.
• Don't include the same kext more than once (e.g. VoodooInput from several kexts) — keep the first, disable the rest.
• It can look very similar to Kernel Panic on Invalid frame pointer.
ts.k_mce.title: Kernel Panic AppleIntelMCEReporter
ts.k_mce.cause: Dual socket support is broken since Catalina, and some AMD boards report multiple socketed CPUs.
ts.k_mce.fix: • Add AppleMCEReporterDisabler to EFI/OC/Kexts and Kernel -> Add.
ts.k_cpu_pm.title: Kernel Panic AppleIntelCPUPowerManagement
ts.k_cpu_pm.cause: Faulty or missing NullCPUPowerManagement. On Penryn and older, IRQ conflicts or a disabled HPET.
ts.k_cpu_pm.fix:
• Remove NullCPUPowerManagement from Kernel -> Add and EFI/OC/Kexts, then enable Kernel -> Emulate -> DummyPowerManagement.
• Penryn and older: SSDTTime's FixHPET, or an ACPI -> Patch "Force HPET Online" (Find A010934F53464C00, Replace A40A0FA3A3A3A3A3).
ts.k_acpiplatform.title: Kernel Panic AppleACPIPlatform in 10.13
ts.k_acpiplatform.cause: High Sierra is stricter with ACPI table headers.
ts.k_trackpad.title: Keyboard works but trackpad does not
ts.k_trackpad.fix:
• VoodooInput must be listed before the VoodooPS2 and VoodooI2C kexts.
• Load order: VoodooGPIO, VoodooInput and VoodooI2CServices (any order), then VoodooI2C, then the satellite/plugin kext.
• SSDT-GPIO in EFI/OC/ACPI and ACPI -> Add.
ts.k_kextd_stall.title: kextd stall[0]: AppleACPICPU
ts.k_kextd_stall.cause: A missing or broken SMC emulator.
ts.k_kextd_stall.fix:
• Lilu and VirtualSMC both in EFI/OC/Kexts and config.plist, Lilu before VirtualSMC.
• Last resort: FakeSMC instead — never VirtualSMC and FakeSMC enabled together.
ts.k_i210.title: Kernel Panic on AppleIntelI210Ethernet
ts.k_i210.cause: Comet Lake boards with the I225-V NIC panic on the I210 kext.
ts.k_i210.fix:
• Use the correct PciRoot for the Ethernet: PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x1C,0x1)/Pci(0x0,0x0) (Asus and Gigabyte default) or PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x1C,0x4)/Pci(0x0,0x0), with device-id F2150000.
• To find it, run gfxutil and grep for 8086:15f3.
ts.k_cd_clock.title: Kernel panic on "Wrong CD Clock Frequency" with Icelake laptop
ts.k_cckprng.title: Kernel panic on "cckprng_int_gen"
ts.k_cckprng.cause: Full panic: "cckprng_int_gen: generator has already been sealed". A missing SMC emulator, or SSDT-CPUR used incorrectly.
ts.k_cckprng.fix:
• Add VirtualSMC.kext to config.plist and the EFI.
• Only use SSDT-CPUR with B550 and A520 — not X570 or older (B450, A320).
ts.k_cs_runtime.title: Stuck at Forcing CS_RUNTIME for entitlement in Big Sur
ts.k_cs_runtime.cause: macOS is sealing the system volume.
ts.k_cs_runtime.fix: • Do not restart — it takes quite some time to complete.
ts.k_ramrod.title: Stuck on ramrod(^^^^^^^^^^^^^)
ts.k_ramrod.cause: Boots, hits this error and reboots in a loop: the SMC emulator is broken.
ts.k_ramrod.fix:
• Use the latest VirtualSMC and Lilu with the vsmcgen=1 boot-arg.
• Or switch to Rehabman's FakeSMC (restricted to Big Sur and up with MinKernel/MaxKernel).
• Never have FakeSMC and VirtualSMC enabled together.
ts.k_vm.title: Virtual Machine Issues
ts.k_vm.fix: • VMware 15 is known to get stuck on [EB|#LOG:EXITBS:START]; VMware 16 resolves it.
ts.k_usb_reboot.title: Reboot on "AppleUSBHostPort::createDevice: failed to create device" on macOS 11.3+
ts.k_usb_reboot.cause: XhciPortLimit breaks with macOS 11.3 and newer.
ts.k_usb_reboot.fix: • Disable Kernel -> Quirks -> XhciPortLimit, after mapping your USB ports correctly.
ts.u_russian.title: macOS installer in Russian
ts.u_russian.cause: The default sample config is in Russian.
ts.u_russian.fix:
• Set NVRAM -> Add -> 7C436110-AB2A-4BBB-A880-FE41995C9F82 -> prev-lang:kbd to 656e2d55533a30 (en-US:0); in a plain text editor that is ZW4tVVM6MA==.
• Reset NVRAM in the boot picker. ThinkPads are known to be semi-bricked by an NVRAM reset in OpenCore — reset NVRAM by updating the BIOS instead.
• Still not working: NVRAM -> Delete -> 7C436110-AB2A-4BBB-A880-FE41995C9F82 -> Item 0 as a String with value prev-lang:kbd.
ts.u_damaged.title: macOS Installer being damaged
ts.u_damaged.cause: An installer downloaded before October 2019 with an expired certificate.
ts.u_damaged.fix:
• Download the newest copy of macOS.
• Or disconnect all networking and set the date to September 1st, 2019 in the recovery terminal.
ts.u_laptop_black.title: Black screen after IOConsoleUsers: gIOScreenLock... on laptops and AIOs
ts.u_laptop_black.fix:
• SSDT-PNLF installed (EFI/OC/ACPI and ACPI -> Add).
• iGPU properties set up correctly under DeviceProperties -> Add -> PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x2,0x0).
• Coffee Lake and newer laptops: add -igfxblr, or enable-backlight-registers-fix | Data | 01000000 on PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x2,0x0).
• Also check "Stuck on or near IOConsoleUsers: gIOScreenLock...".
ts.u_frozen.title: Frozen in the macOS installer after 30 seconds
ts.u_frozen.fix: • Remove NullCPUPowerManagement from Kernel -> Add and EFI/OC/Kexts, then enable Kernel -> Emulate -> DummyPowerManagement.
ts.u_15h_reboot.title: 15h/16h CPU reboot after Data & Privacy screen
ts.u_15h_reboot.fix: • Follow the directions after UPDATE 2 in the "Fix Data and Privacy reboot" post linked from the guide.
ts.u_frozen_login.title: macOS frozen right before login
ts.u_frozen_login.fix:
• For most systems add CpuTscSync.
• Skylake-X: TSCAdjustReset.kext, with Info.plist -> IOKitPersonalities -> IOPropertyMatch -> IOCPUNumber set to your thread count starting from 0 (e.g. 35 for 36 threads).
ts.u_mediakit.title: MediaKit reports not enough space
ts.u_mediakit.cause: Windows creates a 100MB EFI partition, macOS expects 200MB.
ts.u_mediakit.fix:
• Expand the drive's EFI to 200MB.
• Or format the entire drive instead of just the partition (Cmd/Win+2 in Disk Utility shows all devices).
ts.u_erase.title: DiskUtility failing to erase
ts.u_erase.fix:
• Formatting the partition and not the drive (see MediaKit reports not enough space).
• DiskUtility can fail on the first erase — try again.
• Disable SATA Hot-plug in the BIOS.
• Update the drive's firmware.
• It may be a bad drive.
ts.u_sata.title: SATA Drives Not Shown in DiskUtility
ts.u_sata.fix:
• SATA Mode AHCI in the BIOS.
• Unsupported controllers: CtlnaAHCIPort.kext; very legacy ones: AHCIPortInjector.kext.
ts.u_two_minutes.title: Stuck at 2 minutes remaining
ts.u_two_minutes.cause: macOS writes the NVRAM variables for the next boot at this stage, so NVRAM issues stall here.
ts.u_two_minutes.fix:
• 300 series Intel (e.g. Z390): SSDT-PMC.
• Others: LegacyEnable YES, LegacyOverwrite YES, WriteFlash YES.
ts.u_recovery_server.title: The recovery server cannot get contacted
ts.u_recovery_server.cause: An installer made in Windows or Linux is recovery based: the rest of macOS is downloaded from Apple during the install.
ts.u_recovery_server.fix:
• Check you have a working Ethernet or Wi-Fi connection.
• Open Network Utility in the installer: no network card means a missing network kext.
• If the card shows up, run ping in the installer's terminal. Nothing back: network or kexts (try older kext builds). A reply: the issue is on Apple's end — try again later.
ts.u_hid_big_sur.title: Keyboard and Mouse broken in Big Sur
ts.u_hid_big_sur.cause: On legacy systems (Core2 Duo/2010 and older) USB works but HID devices don't.
ts.u_hid_big_sur.fix: • Add a Kernel -> Patch: Base _isSingleUser, Identifier com.apple.iokit.IOHIDFamily, Replace B801000000C3, MinKernel 20.0.0, Count 1, Enabled True.
ts.u_firmware_update.title: Stuck on Your Mac needs a firmware update in order to install to this volume
ts.u_firmware_update.fix:
• PlatformInfo -> Automatic enabled, UpdateSMBIOSMode Create, CustomSMBIOSGuid disabled (Dell and VAIO: CustomSMBIOSGuid enabled with UpdateSMBIOSMode Custom).
• An SMBIOS supported by this macOS version, without -no_compat_check.
• The latest OpenCore.
• Still failing: change to a similar SMBIOS.
ts.p_imessage.title: Broken iMessage and Siri
ts.p_imessage.fix: • See "Fixing iServices" in the Post-Install guide.
ts.p_audio.title: No on-board audio
ts.p_audio.fix: • See "Fixing Audio with AppleALC" in the Post-Install guide.
ts.p_cmos.title: BIOS reset or sent into Safemode after reboot/shutdown
ts.p_cmos.fix: • See "Fixing RTC/CMOS Resets" in the Post-Install guide: try DisableRtcChecksum first (disable it again if it doesn't help), or find and block the bad region with RTCMemoryFixup.
ts.p_synaptics.title: Synaptics PS2 based trackpad doesn't work
ts.p_synaptics.fix:
• Find the trackpad's BIOS device name in Device Manager.
• Use SSDT-Enable_DynamicEWMode.dsl with PCI0.LPCB.PS2K renamed to your path, compile it with MaciASL and add it to OC/ACPI and the config.
• It may be laggy and the physical buttons may not work; without the trackpad, SSDT-DisableTrackpadProbe.dsl may be better.
ts.p_dell_keys.title: Fix for Dell breakless PS2 keyboard keys
ts.p_dell_keys.fix: • Enable VoodooPS2's Dell profile: SSDT-KEY-DELL-WN09.dsl with the keyboard's ACPI path from Device Manager.
ts.p_x570_gpu.title: macOS GPU acceleration missing on AMD X570
ts.p_x570_gpu.fix:
• GPU is UEFI capable (GTX 7XX/2013+).
• CSM is off in the BIOS.
• Force PCIe 3.0 link speed.
ts.p_drm.title: DRM Broken
ts.p_drm.fix: • See "Fixing DRM" in the Post-Install guide.
ts.p_memory_macpro.title: "Memory Modules Misconfigured" on MacPro7,1
ts.p_memory_macpro.fix:
• Follow "Fixing MacPro7,1 Memory Errors".
• To only hide the notification, install RestrictEvents.
ts.p_amd_apps.title: Apps crashing on AMD
ts.p_amd_apps.fix:
• Adobe: the Adobe Fixes disable functionality rather than really fix it.
• VMs on AppleHV (Parallels 15, VMware) don't work; VirtualBox does, as do VMware 10 and older and Parallels 13.1.0 and older.
• Docker: only Docker Toolbox (VirtualBox based), with many features unavailable.
• IDA Pro: the installer has an Intel check; the app itself is likely fine.
• 15h/16h web pages crashing: follow the directions after UPDATE 5 in the linked post.
ts.p_amd_sleep.title: Sleep crashing on AMD
ts.p_amd_sleep.cause: The chipset's USB controller (Ryzen and newer). The log shows "Sleep transition timed out after 180 seconds... Suspected bundle: com.apple.iokit.IOUSBHostFamily".
ts.p_amd_sleep.fix:
• Check which controller is XHC0 in IOReg (Vendor ID 1022 is the AMD chipset).
• Avoid the chipset USB altogether (ideally _STA = 0x0 in an SSDT), or correct the USBX power properties.
ts.p_assetcache.title: AssetCache Content Caching unavailable in virtual machine
ts.p_assetcache.cause: The VMM flag is exposed by sysctl (AssetCacheManagerUtil fails with ACSMErrorDomain Code=5 "virtual machine").
ts.p_coffee_wake.title: Coffee Lake systems failing to wake
ts.p_coffee_wake.cause: AGPM changes in macOS 10.15.4: displays on the iGPU fail to wake.
ts.p_coffee_wake.fix:
• Add igfxonln=1 to boot-args.
• Use WhateverGreen v1.3.8 or newer.
ts.p_brightness.title: No brightness control on Dual GPU laptops
ts.p_brightness.cause: Since macOS 11.3 the dGPU controls the backlight on MUX laptops with the internal screen on the iGPU and external screens on the dGPU (Optimus-only laptops aren't affected).
ts.p_brightness.fix:
• Disable either the iGPU or the dGPU, or:
• Keep SSDT-PNLF installed.
• On PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x2,0x0): @0,backlight-control, applbkl, AAPL,backlight-control and AAPL00,backlight-control = Data 01000000.
• On the dGPU: @0,backlight-control, applbkl and AAPL,backlight-control = Data 00000000.
ts.p_sensors.title: No temperature/fan sensor output
ts.p_sensors.cause: iStat Menus doesn't support MacPro7,1 readouts yet, and VirtualSMC's bundled sensors don't support AMD.
ts.p_sensors.fix:
• AMD: SMCAMDProcessor (early beta, mainly tested on Ryzen) or FakeSMC3_with_plugins.
• With FakeSMC: FileVault needs more work, and no VirtualSMC kexts may be present.
ts.p_startup_disk_error.title: "You can't change the startup disk to the selected disk" error
ts.p_startup_disk_error.cause: Irregular partition setup of the Windows drive — the EFI is not the first partition.
ts.p_startup_disk_apply.title: Selecting Startup Disk doesn't apply correctly
ts.p_startup_disk_apply.cause: Most likely a missing DevicePathsSupported in the I/O Registry.
ts.p_wrong_time.title: macOS waking up with the wrong time
ts.p_wrong_time.cause: Most likely the RTC isn't ticking.
ts.p_wrong_time.fix:
• A new CMOS battery (Z270 and newer are picky with voltage).
• To verify: run VirtualSMC v1.1.5+'s smcread, convert the CLKT value to decimal and divide by 3600 (hours since midnight in Cupertino); sleep, wake and compare.
ts.p_external_monitor.title: No Volume/Brightness control on external monitors
ts.p_external_monitor.cause: macOS has locked down control over digital audio.
ts.p_external_monitor.fix: • The MonitorControl app brings back some of it.
ts.p_time_windows.title: Time inconsistency between macOS and Windows
ts.p_time_windows.cause: macOS uses Universal Time while Windows relies on Greenwich time.
ts.p_time_windows.fix: • Change Windows rather than macOS (far less destructive): install the Bootcamp utilities, or modify Windows' registry (linked from the guide).
ts.p_sip.title: Disabling SIP
ts.p_sip.fix:
• Set NVRAM -> Add -> 7C436110-AB2A-4BBB-A880-FE41995C9F82 -> csr-active-config: 00000000 SIP enabled; 03000000 kext signing and filesystem protections off; FF030000 all High Sierra flags; FF070000 all Mojave/Catalina flags; FF0F0000 all Big Sur flags.
• Add csr-active-config to NVRAM -> Delete so an existing value gets overwritten.
• Disabling SIP can break software updates in Big Sur and newer; CSR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ROOT and CSR_ALLOW_APPLE_INTERNAL are common culprits. Only disable specific values.
ts.p_write_system.title: Writing to the macOS system partition
ts.p_write_system.cause: Since Catalina the system volume is read-only by default.
ts.p_write_system.fix:
• Catalina: disable SIP, then sudo mount -uw /.
• Big Sur and newer: disable SIP and mount the system volume with the commands below (disk5s5 is the guide's example); editing it can break OS updates.
• With SecureBootModel a modified system partition can cause a RecoveryOS boot loop: reset NVRAM and set SecureBootModel to Disabled.
ts.p_snapshots.title: Rolling back APFS Snapshots
ts.p_snapshots.fix: • Reboot into Recovery and select "Restore From Time Machine Backup".
ts.p_watch.title: Apple Watch Unlock issues
ts.p_watch.fix:
• A supported Apple wireless card with Bluetooth Low Energy (4.0+).
• Watch and Mac signed in with the same account.
• iServices working (e.g. iMessage).
• Unlock with Apple Watch available under Security and Privacy.
• Then follow the "Fixing Auto Unlock" guide linked from the page.
ts.p_4k_hdmi.title: 4K iGPU output issues over HDMI
ts.p_4k_hdmi.fix:
• 4K output works in Windows.
• Monitor set explicitly to HDMI 2.0 (DisplayPort 1.2 or higher with an HDMI to DisplayPort converter).
• Enough iGPU memory: 64MB on Broadwell and newer, so framebuffer-stolenmem can be removed.
• Laptops and many desktops may need -cdfon.
ts.m_acpidump.title: Can't run acpidump.efi
ts.m_acpidump.fix: • Call it from the OpenCore shell: switch to the right drive (fs0: as an example), check it with dir, cd to EFI\OC\Tools and run acpidump.efi.
ts.m_ssdttime_iasl.title: Fixing SSDTTime: Could not locate or download iasl!
ts.m_ssdttime_iasl.cause: Usually an outdated version of Python.
ts.m_ssdttime_iasl.fix: • Update Python, or add iasl to SSDTTime's scripts folder.
ts.m_python.title: Fix Python: Python is not installed or not found on PATH
ts.m_python.fix: • Download and install the latest Python, with Add Python to PATH.
ts.m_bootcamp_apfs.title: Windows Startup Disk can't see APFS drives
ts.m_bootcamp_apfs.fix: • Use the newer version from BootCamp Utility in macOS (e.g. 6.1), or CorpNewt's brigadier fork.
ts.m_resolution.title: Incorrect resolution with OpenCore
ts.m_resolution.fix:
• Follow "Fixing Resolution and Verbose"; set UIScale to 2 for HiDPI.
• If ConsoleMode set to Max fails, leave it empty.
ts.m_windows_missing.title: Can't find Windows/BootCamp drive in picker
ts.m_windows_missing.cause: Legacy Windows installs (including those made by BootCamp Assistant) and MBR/Hybrid partitions aren't supported, only UEFI.
ts.m_windows_missing.fix:
• Misc -> Security -> ScanPolicy set to 0.
• Enable Misc -> Boot -> Hideself when the Windows bootloader is on the same drive.
ts.m_windows_bsod.title: Booting Windows results in BlueScreen or Linux crashes
ts.m_windows_bsod.fix: • Enable SyncRuntimePermissions on firmware supporting Memory Attribute Tables (check the log; generally 2018 firmware and newer).
ts.m_already_started.title: Booting Windows error: OCB: StartImage failed - Already started
ts.m_already_started.cause: OpenCore thinks it's booting itself when it boots Windows.
ts.m_already_started.fix: • Move Windows to its own drive, or add a custom drive path under BlessOverride (see Configuration.pdf).
ts.m_iasl_warning.title: iASL warning, only X unresolved
ts.m_iasl_warning.cause: One ACPI table needs the others for references; the DSDT is only used to create a few SSDTs.
ts.m_iasl_warning.fix: • Nothing to fix. To resolve them anyway, decompile all ACPI files together.
